name: Yorba Canyon Center
demographics: Yorba Canyon Center serves an affluent suburban market with household incomes averaging $168,000 within a 3-mile radius, placing it in the top quartile for Orange County and California. The trade area consists primarily of established families and professionals residing in Yorba Linda, which CNN Money magazine has listed as one of the best places to live. The center attracts a diverse customer base seeking convenient access to grocery shopping, banking, dining, and everyday services, with strong daytime traffic from the surrounding high-income neighborhoods and commuters accessing the nearby 91 Freeway.
description: Yorba Canyon Center is a well-established community shopping center located at 21460 Yorba Linda Boulevard in the heart of Yorba Linda, California. Spanning 5.34 acres with 58,136 square feet of gross leasable area and 475 parking stalls, the center has recently completed a comprehensive renovation that includes new electric car charging stations. Anchored by a high-performing Smart & Final Extra, the center features a strong diversity of tenants that consistently attract traffic and business, including Citibank, Jack in the Box, Banfield Pet Hospital, Circle K, Woody's Diner, WaBa Grill, and Coldwell Banker. The center benefits from its strategic location with convenient access to the 91 Freeway and Yorba Linda Boulevard, serving one of Orange County's most desirable communities with household incomes averaging $168,000 within three miles. Situated in an active and expanding market within a business-friendly environment, Yorba Canyon Center offers retailers access to an affluent customer base in a community recognized by CNN Money magazine as one of the best places to live in America.
summary: Yorba Canyon Center is a recently renovated 58,136 square foot community shopping center anchored by Smart & Final Extra in affluent Yorba Linda. The center serves a high-income trade area averaging $168,000 household income and features diverse tenants including Citibank, Jack in the Box, and Woody's Diner with convenient 91 Freeway access.
